definitions.explanation: The act of using reasoning, arguments, or appeals to convince someone to do or believe something. Implies a rational, sustained effort rather than a single request.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{説得|せっとく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{同意|どうい}して→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After persuading them many times, I finally got their agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{説得|せっとく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}がある→説得力がある：25151_settokuryokugaaru⟧。
⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{説得|せっとく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I persuaded my parents and got their permission to study abroad.

notes:
USAGE:
{説得|せっとく} is used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb. The person being persuaded is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{説得|せっとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The very common compound ⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}→説得力：08525_settokuryoku⟧ (persuasive power) describes arguments or presentations that are convincing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {説得|せっとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to persuade
- {説得|せっとく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be persuaded
- ⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}→説得力：08525_settokuryoku⟧: persuasive power, convincingness
- ⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}がある→説得力がある：25151_settokuryokugaaru⟧: to be persuasive/convincing
- {説得|せっとく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧: to accept persuasion
- ⟦{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く→粘り強い：07165_nebarizuyoi⟧{説得|せっとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to persistently persuade

SIMILAR WORDS:
{説得|せっとく} implies a sustained, rational effort to change someone's mind. ⟦{勧|すす}める→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧ (to recommend) is lighter and less forceful. ⟦{口説|くど}く→口説く：11852_kudoku⟧ (to talk someone into something) can be more persistent or nagging, and also means to hit on someone romantically.
